productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Join Mia and Jono as they uncover amazing facts, explore breathtaking habitats and discover fascinating creatures. G’day there! Keen for an explore?When two curious kids named Mia and Jono discover a mysterious map at the start of their school holidays, they soon learn its magical secret. When placed in sunlight, the enchanted map can transport them to every corner of Australia!The two best friends journey through five different regions and talk with the native animals they meet to learn heaps of facts about their unique habitats. Mia captures new discoveries in her notebook, while Jono creates music on his ukelele that’s inspired by the creatures and critters they meet along the way. It’s a bonza way to spend the holidays!Hop along into the outback to see if you can keep up with the spring-loaded “super jump” of Boomer the red kangaroo! Or head to Western Australia to meet Wattle the quokka and see if her famous “resting happy face” is really as cheerful as it looks! Dive into the Great Otway National park to find a “secret river” with Banks the platypus, trek through the Daintree rainforest with Kora the cassowary and climb high into the eucalyptus trees of New South Wales to help a sleepy koala named Kip find his favourite snack.This collection includes:The Kangaroo’s Super Jump  The Happiest Quokka The Platypus and the Secret River  The Cassowary’s Rainforest Quest Koala’s Missing Gum LeavesThese audio adventures are a ripper way to explore the continent! Test your knowledge at the end of each story and see if you can become an Aussie animal expert! productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
G’day there! Keen for an explore?


When two curious kids named Mia and Jono discover a mysterious map at the start of their school holidays, they soon learn its magical secret. When placed in sunlight, the enchanted map can transport them to every corner of Australia!


The two best friends journey through five different regions and talk with the native animals they meet to learn heaps of facts about their unique habitats. Mia captures new discoveries in her notebook, while Jono creates music on his ukelele that’s inspired by the creatures and critters they meet along the way. It’s a bonza way to spend the holidays!


Hop along into the outback to see if you can keep up with the spring-loaded “super jump” of Boomer the red kangaroo! Or head to Western Australia to meet Wattle the quokka and see if her famous “resting happy face” is really as cheerful as it looks! Dive into the Great Otway National park to find a “secret river” with Banks the platypus, trek through the Daintree rainforest with Kora the cassowary and climb high into the eucalyptus trees of New South Wales to help a sleepy koala named Kip find his favourite snack.


This collection includes:


The Kangaroo’s Super Jump  

The Happiest Quokka 

The Platypus and the Secret River  

The Cassowary’s Rainforest Quest 

Koala’s Missing Gum Leaves


These audio adventures are a ripper way to explore the continent! Test your knowledge at the end of each story and see if you can become an Aussie animal expert!
